an5.165:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhu āmantesi …pe… yo hi koci āvuso, paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so pañcahi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an5.165:1.3: mandattā momuhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati. pāpiccho icchāpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati. paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati. aññātukāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati. athavā panevaṃcitto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati:
an5.165:1.4: “sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva vyākarissati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ; no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva vyākarissati, ahamassa sammadeva vyākarissāmī” ti.
an5.165:1.5: yo hi koci āvuso, paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an5.165:1.6: ahaṃ kho panāvuso, evaṃ citto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchāmi:
an5.165:1.7: “sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva vyākarissati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ. no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva vyākarissati, ahamassa sammadeva vyākarissāmī”ti.
